live.title: Live selling with an AI avatar
live.subtitle: A Thai-speaking avatar that sells from a script, answers comments from your shop facts, and can go live on TikTok / Facebook

status.unreachable: Cannot reach the AI Live box:

setup.title: AI Live box not connected
setup.desc: Install deploy/ai-live on the GPU box, then enter its address and the token printed by the installer

stage.title: Live stage
stage.off: Start the avatar to see the preview
stage.startedSlow: Started; the avatar is still loading
stage.freeGpuHint: Unload Unsloth image/video models from the GPU so the avatar has enough memory
stage.noModel: wav2lip.pth is missing on the GPU box (see deploy/ai-live/README.md)
stage.previewFailed: Preview failed — check that port 8000 (TCP/UDP) is open

push.title: Go live on a platform
push.noTarget: No RTMP URL + stream key yet (in settings)
push.confirmMessage: The avatar video and audio will be broadcast publicly on {host} right away

say.title: Type for the avatar to say

product.name: Product name
product.detailsPh: Ingredients, size, how to use, verifiable selling points
product.promoPh: e.g. Buy 3 get 1 free, live only

comments.title: Answer comments
comments.faq: Shop facts the AI may use
comments.faqPh: Shipping fee, delivery time, payment, return policy, sizes/colours
comments.needProduct: Enter the product name first so the AI answers from real facts
comments.autoSpeak: Avatar says the answer right away (cuts into the script)

settings.title: Connect the AI Live box
settings.desc: Address and token come from the installer on the GPU box (deploy/ai-live/install.sh) — the token and stream key stay on the server and are never shown again
settings.rtmpHint: Copy it from TikTok / Facebook Live Producer — anyone with the stream key can broadcast on your channel
settings.tiktokUser: TikTok channel to read comments from
settings.tiktokHint: Uses the unofficial tiktok-live-connector through the Euler Stream sign server — free but rate limited; add a key if you connect often

tiktok.title: TikTok LIVE comments
tiktok.usernamePh: TikTok channel that is live (e.g. nakashop)
tiktok.autoThanks: Avatar thanks gifts and new followers

avatar.create: New avatar from a photo / video
avatar.title: Create your avatar
avatar.desc: Upload a photo or video of yourself; it becomes an avatar that lip-syncs Thai speech on the live stream
avatar.name: Avatar name
avatar.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, _ or -, 3–41 characters, e.g. naka_host_ann
avatar.video: Your video (MP4 / MOV / WebM, up to 50 MB)
avatar.tipPhoto1: Face the camera, shoulders visible, mouth closed, even light, nothing covering the face
avatar.tipPhoto2: AI first makes a ~10 s idle video from the photo (breathing, blinking, a small smile); about 20–30 minutes in total
avatar.tipPhoto3: Making the video uses the whole GPU, so stop the running avatar first
avatar.tipVideo1: 10–60 seconds, facing the camera, still or talking softly, steady camera
avatar.tipVideo2: Face clearly visible in every frame, no profile shots, nothing covering the mouth
avatar.tipVideo3: Vertical 9:16 fits mobile live best; building takes a few minutes
avatar.stopFirst: Stop the avatar before creating one from a photo
avatar.consent: I confirm this is my own face, or its owner has agreed to it being used as an avatar
avatar.startedPhoto: Started: AI is making a video from the photo (about 20–30 min)
